CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tickets_refresh_all_show_tickets_sold_out()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    UPDATE shows
    SET tickets_sold_out = sub.tickets_sold_out
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.id AS show_id,
            COALESCE(
                BOOL_AND(t.sold_out) FILTER (WHERE t.id IS NOT NULL),
                false
            ) AS tickets_sold_out
        FROM shows s
        LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.show_id = s.id
        GROUP BY s.id
    ) sub
    WHERE shows.id = sub.show_id;

    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_show_min_price(p_show_id integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    UPDATE shows
    SET min_price = (
        SELECT MIN(price)
        FROM tickets
        WHERE show_id = p_show_id
          AND price IS NOT NULL
          AND price > 0
    )
    WHERE id = p_show_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_show_tickets_sold_out(p_show_id integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    UPDATE shows
    SET tickets_sold_out = COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT BOOL_AND(sold_out)
            FROM tickets
            WHERE show_id = p_show_id
        ),
        false
    )
    WHERE id = p_show_id;
END;
$function$
